title: Unique item
wikitext: [[File:Broken Faith art.jpg|thumb|upright|Artwork depicting the unique shield, {{il|Broken Faith}}]] A '''unique item''' is an [[item]] with a specific name, unique artwork, and a predetermined list of [[modifier]]s. Unique items usually have the same [[implicit modifier]] as a [[normal]] item of the same type. Unique items are meant to be less powerful overall than high-level rare items, but offer unique gameplay and allow special character builds to be based around them.{{Citation needed|reason=This must have a citation, since it speaks to GGG's intent.}} Currently there are '''{{drop enabled unique item count}}''' released unique items, including [[maps]] and items with modifier variants. For a timeline when each unique item was added, see the [[timeline of unique items]]. This list does not include unique [[strongbox]]es and [[Vaal side area]]s. ==Unique item types{{anchor|UniqueItemTypes}}== {| |- | [[File:Jewellery item icon.png|80px|link=List of unique jewellery|alt=]] | [[List of unique jewellery|Jewellery]] {{flatlist| * [[List of unique amulets|Amulets]] * [[List of unique belts|Belts]] * [[List of unique rings|Rings]] }} |- | [[File:Armour item icon.png|80px|link=List of unique armour|alt=]] | [[List of unique armour|Armour]] {{flatlist| * [[List of unique body armours|Body armours]] * [[List of unique boots|Boots]] * [[List of unique gloves|Gloves]] * [[List of unique helmets|Helmets]] * [[List of unique shields|Shields]] * [[List of unique quivers|Quivers]] }} |- | [[File:Weapon item icon.png|80px|link=List of unique weapons|alt=]] | [[List of unique weapons|Weapons]] {{flatlist| * [[List of unique axes|Axes]] * [[List of unique bows|Bows]] * [[List of unique claws|Claws]] * [[List of unique daggers|Daggers]] * [[List of unique fishing rods|Fishing rods]] * [[List of unique maces|Maces]] * [[List of unique sceptres|Sceptres]] * [[List of unique staves|Staves]] * [[List of unique swords|Swords]] * [[List of unique wands|Wands]] }} |- | [[File:Flask item icon.png|80px|link=List of unique flasks|alt=]] | [[List of unique flasks|Flasks]] {{flatlist| * [[List of unique life flasks|Life]] * [[List of unique mana flasks|Mana]] * [[List of unique hybrid flasks|Hybrid]] * [[List of unique utility flasks|Utility]] }} |- | [[File:Jewel item icon.png|80px|link=List of unique jewels|alt=]] | [[List of unique jewels|Jewels]] |- | [[File:Map item icon.png|80px|link=List of unique maps|alt=]] | [[List of unique maps|Maps]] |} ==Obtaining unique items== The following is a non-exhaustive list of ways that unique items can be obtained. Unique items can always be [[trade]]d. * '''World drops:''' Unique items, like items of any other rarity, can randomly drop from slain [[monster]]s and [[loot container]]s. A unique item's [[drop level]] may differ from that of its base item. The actual drop levels of unique items are not known; however, there are examples of unique items that are known to only drop from very high level content, such as [[map]]s. Each unique item also has its own drop rate. These rates are not publicized by [[Grinding Gear Games]], but certain unique items are clearly much more common than others. * '''Optional content:''' Optional game content is a prevalent source of unique items. Random unique item drops are often given to the player as reward for engaging with certain optional game content such as [[Heist]], the [[Immortal Syndicate]] and [[the Lord's Labyrinth]] just to name a few. They are sometimes indicated by a [[File:Uniques reward icon.png|20px|uniques reward]] icon. Additionally, a number of [[drop-restricted]] unique items can only be acquired from optional game content and bosses. * '''Orb of Chance:''' Using an {{il|Orb of Chance}} on a normal item will very rarely upgrade it to a unique item of the same base type. For example, it is possible for a normal {{il|Gold Ring}} to be upgraded to {{il|Andvarius}} by using an Orb of Chance on it. Similarly, a {{il|Tainted Mythic Orb}} can also transform a [[corrupted]] item into a unique item with a risk of destroying it. These methods cannot be used to obtain drop-restricted unique items. * '''Purchasing:''' [[Gambling]] and special NPCs like [[Cadiro Perandus]] and the [[Nameless Seer]] allow you to buy or take unique items from them. * '''Vaal Orb:''' [[List of unique jewels received by corruption|Certain jewel]]s and equipment can only be created through one possible outcome of using a {{il|Vaal Orb}} on an item. For example, using a Vaal Orb on {{il|Tear of Purity}} may result in it transforming into {{il|Blood of Corruption}}. * '''Upgrading:''' Some unique items can be deterministically transformed into alternate versions. See [[vial]]s, {{il|Flesh of Xesht}}, and {{il|Coin of Restoration}} for more information. * '''Transforming''': {{il|Ancient Orb}} and the [[Altar of Sacrifice]] in [[the Temple of Atzoatl]] can transform a unique item into another random unique item. This cannot be used to obtain drop-restricted items. * '''Vendor recipes:''' [[List of unique items created with vendor recipes|Certain unique items]] can be created using [[Vendor recipe system|vendor recipes]]. For most them, the vendor recipe is the only way to obtain it. * '''Divination cards:''' Sets of many [[divination card]]s can be turned in for unique items. Some like {{il|Thunderous Skies}} return specific unique items, whereas others like {{il|Jack in the Box}} return random ones. A few unique items like {{il|Maw of Mischief}} can only be acquired from specific divination card sets. * '''Event prizes:''' In the past, special unique items were given as [[Event prize|prizes]] to players who placed in competitive events like [[race]]s. ==Legacy variants== Like all items, unique items can have [[legacy variant]]s. This means for some uniques there exist better (or worse) versions that aren't dropping anymore in [[Standard league]]s. The main source of legacy items are nerfs that affect future item drops, but leave the already existing items as they were. The only way to get these legacy items is from players who had them before they were changed. Rerolling the item's modifier values with a {{il|Divine Orb}} may change a mod's values to match the current version of the unique item, but not for all of them. It will not add or remove modifiers that have been adjusted since then as well. ==Other information== * A unique item, easily spotted by its {{c|unique|orange text}} and orange banner, as well as a distinct sound affect and animation upon monster drop is one that always spawns with the same mods (sometimes with different values) on the same base item with the same requirements. * {{il|Mirror of Kalandra|Mirrors of Kalandra}} and {{il|Orb of Scouring|Orbs of Scouring}} cannot be used on unique items. The only way to downgrade a unique is to use a {{il|Vaal Orb}} on it, which can turn it into a corrupted rare item. * [[Event prize]] unique items were given out during old [[race]] events to select top players and new copies cannot be obtained in-game by any other method. * Unique items with [[List of alternate art items|alternate 2D artworks]] were given out as prizes for [[races]]. * [[Foil]] uniques are variants with alternate "holographic" 2D artworks. They are obtained using a [[Reliquary Key]], which very rarely drop in-game, some only for a limited time. Certain [[supporter pack]]s allows the buyer to add a foil unique of their choosing into the game, obtainable through special items. * [[Foulborn unique item]]s are special variants of unique items which have at least one of its usual modifiers replaced with a similar Foulborn modifier. * [[Enshrouding crystal]]s are used to create [[Vestigial unique item]]s. Using a crystal on a valid unique item will turn them enshrouded, which can be taken to the [[Domain of Timeless Conflict]] and placed in a Crystal of Permutation, where it will gather kills made during the encounter. Once the crystal has gained enough charges, it can be broken to obtain a random drop-unrestricted unique with an [[implicit]] modifier based on the enshrouded unique. * It is possible to get an [[influenced item|influenced]] version of a unique item (for unique items that do not normally drop influenced) by using an {{il|Orb of Chance}} on an influenced version of the base item. * It is impossible to transform a non-unique [[fractured item|fractured]] or [[synthesised item|synthesised]] item or an item with an [[Eldritch implicit modifier]] into a unique item. * The [[item level]] of the unique affects how many sockets can appear on it. While the stats may be the same a unique with a high item level may have a higher selling price when trading with other players. * There are different [[Guide:Analysis of unique item tiers|tiers of unique items]]. On drop, the rarity roll determines not only if the item will be unique but also from which tier. A random unique will then be pick from the determined tier's pool. When chancing, the probability of obtaining each tier is fixed. If there is no unique of the rolled tier or lower, a rare will be chanced instead.[https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/485201/filter-account-type/staff On chancing] and [https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/488664/filter-account-type/staff On dropping] Path of Exile Forums ==Unique items designed by supporters== {{See also|Category:Unique items created by supporters}} During the [[Closed Beta]] phase of [[Path of Exile]]'s development, supporters of the game that purchased the [[Closed Beta supporter pack#Diamond|Diamond supporter pack]] were given the opportunity to collaborate on the design of a unique item. For a period of time at the start of the [[Open Beta]], [[Grinding Gear Games]] offered supporters a unique item design opportunity as a standalone purchase. Once the Open Beta supporter packs were made available, [[Open Beta supporter pack#Eternal|Eternal]] and [[Open Beta supporter pack#Ruler_of_Wraeclast|Ruler of Wraeclast]] supporters were likewise also given the opportunity to design a unique item. ==See also== * [[Timeline of unique items]] * [[List of unique items with legacy variants]] * [[List of unique items with custom effects]] * [[List of unique talking items]] * [[List of alternate art items]] * [[Guide:Analysis of unique item tiers]] ==References== {{Reflist|refs= {{cite web |author = Chris |date = November 6, 2013 |title = Further Update to Map-only Uniques |url = http://web.archive.org/web/20131109054522/https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/585724 |publisher = Official Path of Exile Forums |accessdate = November 9, 2013 }} {{cite web |author = Chris |date = August 9, 2012 |title = 0.9.11g Patch Notes |url = https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/44330 |publisher = Official Path of Exile Forums |accessdate = November 8, 2021 }} {{cite web |title = https://www.pathofexile.com/purchase |url = http://web.archive.org/web/20120512154002/https://www.pathofexile.com/purchase |publisher = Official Path of Exile Website |accessdate = May 12, 2012 }} {{cite web |title = https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/category/custom-content |url = https://web.archive.org/web/20130910164500/https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/category/custom-content |publisher = Official Path of Exile Website |accessdate = September 10, 2013 }} {{cite web |title = https://www.pathofexile.com/purchase |url = http://web.archive.org/web/20130730034106/https://www.pathofexile.com/purchase/ |publisher = Official Path of Exile Website |accessdate = July 30, 2013 }} }} ==External links== * [https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1835899 Forum thread listing and discussing unique items] {{Navbox Unique Items}} [[Category:Unique items| ]] [[Category:Item mechanics]] {{sister|poe2wiki}}
